persona.backstory: Son of a rope-maker who died in the fever of 1340, leaving a hank of unpaid debt and a bench in the Arsenale. Marco walks to work along the fondamenta before dawn, keeps his mother Agnese fed, and counts the ducats it would take to put his own name over a warehouse door at the Rialto.

Money 0 ducats · health 39 · energy 100 · hunger 0 · work: ropemaker.
Mother says: "The priest asked after you again."
Nearby: Agnese (mother).
Market: boat 132 · bread 2 · good_meal 7 · medicine 20 · plain_meal 3 · warehouse 495 · wine 3.
You still want to: own a warehouse on the Rialto; keep the family fed and alive; die without debts.

wrote: 1349 Summer (t=37, age 31): health crashed to 47, hunger 13, energy 30 — life-threatening crisis**, likely plague/starvation compounding after the Black Death seasons and the hunger-zero episode. Emergency response: full rest, no work, all money into food. This is the most dangerous point in Marco's life so far.
Health at 47, hunger near nothing. I frightened myself this time. Everything stops — no work, just rest and food until I'm whole again.
retrieved: Health crashed to 47, hunger to 13 — full emergency rest, prioritizing survival over everything else this season

talk.say: Resting wasn't enough without coin for food. I'm working again, eating simply, until we have enough saved that hunger isn't a fear anymore.

payload.diary: Health kept falling even resting — I understand now, it was hunger, not tiredness, killing my strength. Back to work, eating simply but affordably, mother close by.
recall: Health fell to 39 despite rest — the real problem was unaffordable food, not lack of rest. Working for income and eating a cheaper, sustainable tier this time.

wrote: 1349 Autumn (t=38): health kept falling to 39 despite full rest + "eat good"** — money hit 0 and hunger hit 0 again. CRITICAL LESSON: rest alone does NOT fix health if hunger is starved — need actual MONEY to buy food, and resting with zero income while "eat good" is too expensive just burns through cash without fully feeding. The real fix is WORK for income + a food tier I can actually afford for all 13 weeks, not just resting. Switching to eat:"poor" (cheapest tier) while working this next turn to test if affordability (not resting) is what restores hunger/health.
